identity.name: The Guardian
identity.description: A British daily and global digital news organisation known for liberal-progressive journalism, investigations, climate coverage and opinion.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by the Scott Trust, whose constitution is intended to secure editorial independence and reinvest profits in journalism rather than distribute them to shareholders.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Scott Trust structure protects editorial independence; the paper takes explicit editorial positions, especially on social and environmental issues.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center and High factual reporting; editorial and opinion consistently lean progressive, while news reporting is professionally sourced.

economicPerspective.evidence: Generally social-democratic and sceptical of concentrated corporate power, but not uniformly state-directed.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Strong emphasis on climate, human rights and international law; critical of authoritarian governments and sometimes of UK/US policy.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; long record of corrections, investigations and named sourcing.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Liberal-progressive global voice. Prioritises climate, human rights, inequality and civil liberties, with strong investigative capacity and a sceptical posture toward concentrated corporate and state power.

selectionRationale: Adds a high-quality centre-left perspective with strong climate, investigations and human-rights coverage, balancing right-leaning and state-aligned sources.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Scott Trust ownership is a key independence safeguard. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
